sections.section_title: TIM DMA address for full transfer (TIM_DMAR)
sections.text_helper: Section 31.6.35 "TIM DMA address for full transfer (TIM_DMAR)" in chapter 31 (Advanced-control timers (TIM1/TIM8)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1128.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x3E0
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 DMAB[31:0]: DMA register for burst accesses
A read or write operation to the DMAR register accesses the register located at the address
(TIM_CR1 address) + (DBA + DMA index) x 4
where TIM_CR1 address is the address of the control register 1, DBA is the DMA base
address configured in TIM_DCR register, DMA index is automatically controlled by the DMA
transfer, and ranges from 0 to DBL (DBL configured in TIM_DCR).
